name: cfg-provider-capabilities
about: speedMapping 与几项模型能力键（parseModelConfig.ts:125-147 parseSpeedMapping、:250-310 parseCapabilities / applyOfficialSpeedDefault；gateway/dialog/modelCatalog.ts:31、74-80；model/request/validateModelRequest.ts:32；providers/openai/request.ts:87、anthropic/request.ts:117；streamModel.ts:831 fast-mode beta 头；context/DefaultContextRuntime.ts:392 缓存断点）：官方 id openai 缺省 openai_service_tier + supportsSpeed；anthropic 协议显式 anthropic_speed；openai 协议显式 openai_service_tier；不配 speedMapping 时 supportsSpeed 无效；speed=1 与 speed=0.2 的请求体；supportsPromptCache=false 去掉 anthropic 缓存断点；supportsThinking / supportsJsonSchema 只被解析（运行时不读）；非法值各一（speedMapping 与协议不配 / 未知值、能力不是布尔、contextWindow 非正（contextWindow 的作用见 cfg-provider-context-window））。比 model_catalog_list、resolve_settings、各轮事件和 provider 收到的请求。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    openai:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/oa/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        bbx-gpt:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    anth:
      protocol: anthropic
      url: {MOCK}/anth/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      speedMapping: anthropic_speed
      models:
        fast:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
            supportsSpeed: true
        nocache:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
            supportsPromptCache: false
    oaism:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/oaism/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      speedMapping: openai_service_tier
      models:
        fast:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
            supportsSpeed: true
            supportsThinking: false
            supportsJsonSchema: false
        slow:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    oainosm:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/oainosm/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        fast:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
            supportsSpeed: true
    bad1:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      speedMapping: anthropic_speed
      models:
        m: {}
    bad2:
      protocol: anthropic
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      speedMapping: fast
      models:
        m: {}
    bad3:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        m:
          capabilities:
            supportsSpeed: "yes"
    bad4:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        m:
          capabilities:
            supportsPromptCache: 1
    bad5:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        m:
          capabilities:
            contextWindow: 0
    bad6:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        m:
          capabilities:
            supportsJsonSchema: null
            supportsThinking: false
telemetry:
  enabled: false
